target_formulation.rationale: Raw Rc exhibits heavy positive skew (skewness=2.50). Log10 transformation normalizes residuals (skewness=0.44) and matches logarithmic resistance scaling across orders of magnitude.

redundant_collinear_pairs.action: Drop schottky_mott_barrier_ev because it is an exact linear shift (Phi_M - 4.2)
Keep work_function_ev as primary physical descriptor; use electronegativity only in multivariate tree models

cross_validation_strategy.rationale: Standard random K-Fold suffers from data leakage due to intra-laboratory correlation. Grouped splitting tests generalization to completely unseen fabrication labs and literature sources.

evaluation_metrics.name: RMSE_log10_rc
evaluation_metrics.description: Root Mean Squared Error on log10(Rc), representing average order-of-magnitude error (dex).

evaluation_metrics.name: MAE_log10_rc
evaluation_metrics.description: Mean Absolute Error on log10(Rc), robust to individual experimental outliers.

evaluation_metrics.name: Spearman_rho
evaluation_metrics.description: Monotonic rank correlation, invariant to non-linear monotonic calibrations.

evaluation_metrics.name: Pearson_r
evaluation_metrics.description: Linear correlation between predicted and experimental log10(Rc).
